PRACTICE AREAS

Real estate & leases

Title checks, purchases and sales, leases and evictions. Including buyers from abroad.

Buying or leasing property is often the biggest transaction you will make. We check the property before you sign, so you know exactly what you are buying and what you are signing.

What we handle

  • Title checks at the Cadastre or the Land Registry
  • Purchases, sales and parental gifts of property
  • Drafting and reviewing leases
  • Evictions and claims for unpaid rent
  • Support for buyers abroad, through a power of attorney

What to bring to the first meeting

  • The title deed or the contract the seller gave you
  • The KAEK code, if the property is in the Cadastre
  • The listing or the property details
  • The lease, for rental matters

Frequently asked questions

How long does a title check take?

Usually one to three weeks, depending on whether the property is in the Cadastre and on its history. We tell you upfront what to expect.

Can I buy property without coming to Greece?

Yes. With a power of attorney we can represent you throughout. You'll need a Greek tax number (AFM), which we can also obtain for you.
